news.title: SLU Partners With Harris-Stowe State University for Accelerated Bachelor's to Master's Pathway in Social Work
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University and Harris-Stowe State University have teamed up for an accelerated bachelor's to master's in social work. The program is designed to create new opportunities for HSSU students to continue their education and prepare for professional careers.
